Overview.Name: Santhosh Varma Manthina
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed for best results

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (3 eggs) pan fried & vegetable dosa (1)
Option 2: Chicken pieces (small bowl) & idli (2) & sambar
Option 3: Puffed rice (2 cups) & 2 boiled eggs
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & grilled chicken (palm size) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & fish fry (pan fried) & spinach curry
Option 3: Chicken biryani (home style, moderate portion) & salad
Meal_3: Option 1: Cooked rice (1/2 cup cooked ~75 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Chicken stir fry (light portion) & cucumber salad
Option 3: Clear vegetable soup (1 large bowl) & grilled fish (small portion)

Notes_and_Tips: Since your motivation is energy and results, keep protein portions strong at each meal to improve body composition.
Because biryani is a craving, include it in controlled home style portions instead of avoiding it completely.
During social gatherings eat chicken or eggs first so rice intake naturally reduces.
Keep dinner lighter than lunch to support better sleep during shift work.
Simple pan fried or grilled cooking will help you stay consistent.
